description: Ground truth for 20-model comparison test using test_prompts/models/
cross_reference_insight: The model with the highest heating load (HotelLarge_Minneapolis at 1894.57 GJ) has only 3.83 unmet hrs, while models with the most unmet hours (20.67 hrs) have lower heating loads (1484.28 GJ). Higher capacity/load does not imply more unmet hours — unmet hours depend on equipment sizing relative to peak demand, not total annual consumption.
note_on_data: These 20 models use duplicated output data from 6 source simulations. Multiple models will show identical values when sourced from the same simulation.
